title: Edmund and the Garden
author: Xanthe Reyes
blurb: Felix Almeida, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
